data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: Differ is a pure function: same (local_state, jira_state) input produces byte-identical canonical manifest across N invocations
- dd-4: Differ MUST NOT emit (outbound, create) for any local ticket whose dso_local_id is already present in the fetched Jira working set

Rewrite plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py to expose diff(local_state, jira_state) -> list[Mutation]. Precompute bound_local_ids: set[str] from jira_state. Emit (outbound, create) for local tickets whose dso_local_id is NOT in bound_local_ids. Explicitly skip (outbound, create) for already-bound (dd-4). Emit (outbound, update) / (inbound, update) for bound tickets that differ. Pure: no I/O, no time, no globals, no logging.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given local_state with two tickets {A: dso_local_id=A, B: dso_local_id=B} and jira_state whose working set contains dso_local_id=A; When diff is called; Then result has exactly one (outbound, create) targeting B and zero create mutations for A. Purity: 10 invocations on identical input produce serialize-identical manifests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py
- [ ] diff excludes (outbound, create) for already-bound dso_local_id
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py::test_no_outbound_create_for_already_bound_local_id
- [ ] diff is pure: N invocations on identical input produce serialize-identical manifests
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py::test_diff_is_pure_across_n_invocations
- [ ] diff returns list[Mutation]
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py::test_diff_returns_mutation_list

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py — Edit (rewrite)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
data.title: Rewrite differ.py as pure function emitting Mutations with dso_local_id-already-bound exclusion
